name: MenuItem
title: Menu Item
description: One menu entry: a label, and either a target page or an external URL. Not both.

fields.name: target
fields.label: Target page
fields.description: The friendly URL of the page this points at. Leave empty for an external link.

fields.name: href
fields.label: External URL
fields.description: An absolute URL, for an entry that leaves the site. Ignored when a target is set.

fields.name: rel
fields.label: Link relationship
fields.description: Emitted as rel= — what an external entry needs and an internal one does not.
